from PIL import Image
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import os

def task_func(img_path, angle):
    if not os.path.exists(img_path):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Image file does not exist at the specified path: {img_path}")
    
    original_img = Image.open(img_path)
    rotated_img = original_img.rotate(angle, expand=True)
    
    original_array = np.array(original_img)
    rotated_array = np.array(rotated_img)
    
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 6))
    
    axes[0].imshow(original_img)
    axes[0].set_title("Original Image")
    axes[0].axis("off")
    
    axes[1].imshow(rotated_img)
    axes[1].set_title(f"Rotated Image ({angle}°)")
    axes[1].axis("off")
    
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
    
    return original_array, rotated_array
